label: Label and value
description: A compact, always read-only pair of a label and a value — either a field's display value or fixed text. Use it for summary sidebars and headers where values should be scanned, not edited ("Requester: Ana Ruiz"). Use a field placement when the value should be editable.
usage: Use in summary cards and sidebars for 3–8 key facts.
Bind to a field for live values; use text only for fixed explanatory values.
Keep labels to one or two words.
constraints: label is required (at most 60 characters); exactly one of field or text must be set.
field must be a key of the view's entity; values follow field permissions and a value the viewer cannot read is not rendered.
Lookup values the viewer cannot read show "Restricted record".

binding.description: Read-only binding to one field's display value, or fixed text.

accessibility.keyboard: Not focusable unless the value is a link (user, lookup, email), which takes Tab and Enter.
accessibility.notes: Rendered as a description-list pair (dt/dd) so the label is announced with the value.

responsive: Label beside value when the cell is at least 320px wide, otherwise label above value.
